description: SpaceMiT K3: 16 riscv64 harts on shared memory. X100 = harts 0-7 (VLEN=256), A100 = harts 8-15 (VLEN=1024). Facts below were measured on the board.

notes.clusters: X100 = CPUs 0-7, A100 = CPUs 8-15. L2 is shared per group of 4 cores (0-3 and 8-11 confirmed by measurement). /proc/cpuinfo reports the same ISA string on all 16 harts, so the core type is not discoverable from it.
notes.vlen: X100 vlenb=32 (VLEN 256); A100 vlenb=128 (VLEN 1024). Both are legal for zvl256b, which is only a lower bound.
notes.a100_isa: The A100 is deliberately treated as X100-ISA-only for now: same capability list, same rvv_k3 backend (-march=rv64gcv_zvl256b_zfh_zvfh). Correctness on VLEN=1024 depends on every kernel being VL-agnostic and is checked by golden runs pinned to harts 8-15, not assumed.
notes.ai_thread_cpus: Threads that run on the A100 must write their TID to /proc/set_ai_thread (done by the runtime, never from a shell). Registration is ONE-WAY: there is no unregister, so a thread that has joined the A100 pool stays there. The process itself starts on the X100 (taskset -c 0-7) and A100 worker threads self-register. `ai_thread_cpus` lists the harts that need this; build scripts pass it as AI_CPUS= / -DMODELBLASTER_AI_CPUS= in compact form (e.g. 8-15).
notes.clock: rdtime is unprivileged and runs at 24 MHz, same as the K1. Timing must convert with 24 MHz, never the core clock.
notes.core_kind: X100 and A100 are DISTINCT kinds (x100 / a100) even though they share one capability list and one backend. `kind` is what _resolve_target uses to pick a hart -- the n-th core OF THAT KIND -- so one shared kind would make CPU_E#n alias CPU_P#n and double-book harts 0-7 (see the K1 notes). Here CPU_P = x100, CPU_E = a100.
notes.ime: No ime_* capability is declared: the K3 IME has not been characterised, and the K1 smt.vmadot facts do not transfer.

cores.name: x100_core0
cores.description: X100, VLEN=256 (vlenb=32). L2 domain shared with harts 0-3. RVV only; no IME capability.

cores.name: a100_core8
cores.description: A100, VLEN=1024 (vlenb=128). L2 domain shared with harts 8-11. Treated as X100-ISA-only (zvl256b) for now; kernels must be VL-agnostic.
